units.source_text: 在热海，一月十八日这个忌辰的日子，是很容易记牢的。

en.t: In Atami, the memorial day of January eighteenth is very easy to remember.

units.source_text: 因为《金色夜叉》中的贯一在热海海边说了一句“本月今晚的月亮”的台词，

en.t: Because Kanichi in The Golden Demon spoke the line, "the moon on this night of this month," on the shore at Atami,

units.source_text: 人们为了纪念他，便把一月十七日定为红叶节。

en.t: people commemorated him by designating January seventeenth as the Koyo Festival.

units.source_text: 秀哉名人的忌辰，就是红叶节的次日。

en.t: The death anniversary of Master Shusai falls on the day after the Koyo Festival.
